items.title: Microbiome and metabolites impact enteric and central nervous systems in ALS.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) has been linked to gastrointestinal symptoms and alterations in the gut microbiota. The enteric nervous system (ENS) coordinates intestinal function and sits at the host-microbe interface. The mechanisms by which luminal changes relay to the central nervous system (CNS), where motor neurons reside, have yet to be completely defined. In this narrative review, we first present evidence from ALS patient cohorts and preclinical models alongside mechanistic studies of infection, dysbiosis, and related neurodegenerative diseases to discuss how the microbiota and its metabolites may affect the ENS and CNS in ALS. Next, we propose a plausible mechanism of ALS pathogenesis through the gut-microbiome-brain axis. We further offer a summary of clinical trials that have studied the impacts of the microbiota on human ALS. Finally, we discuss future directions for studies of microbiota-ENS-CNS interactions in ALS. Better understanding of the dynamic interactions among the microbiota, microbial metabolites, neuroactive metabolites, and inflammation through the ENS/CNS in ALS will provide innovative insights into ALS prevention and treatment.
items.titleZh: 微生物组和代谢物影响ALS中的肠道和中枢神经系统
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了ALS中肠道微生物群及其代谢物通过肠-微生物-脑轴影响肠道神经系统和中枢神经系统的证据，并提出了可能的发病机制。
items.insight: 该综述整合了临床和临床前证据，提出了微生物群-ENS-CNS轴在ALS发病中的新机制，为基于微生物组的ALS干预策略提供了理论基础。

aiRead.keyFinding: 肠道微生物群及其代谢物通过肠-微生物-脑轴影响ALS中的肠道和中枢神经系统，可能参与ALS发病机制。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与胃肠道症状和肠道微生物群改变有关。肠道神经系统（ENS）协调肠道功能，并位于宿主-微生物界面。管腔变化如何传递到运动神经元所在的中枢神经系统（CNS）的机制尚未完全明确。在这篇叙述性综述中，我们首先呈现来自ALS患者队列和临床前模型的证据，以及感染、菌群失调和相关神经退行性疾病的机制研究，以讨论微生物群及其代谢物如何影响ALS中的ENS和CNS。接下来，我们通过肠-微生物-脑轴提出ALS发病机制的一种可能机制。我们进一步总结了研究微生物群对人类ALS影响的临床试验。最后，我们讨论了ALS中微生物群-ENS-CNS相互作用研究的未来方向。更好地理解ALS中微生物群、微生物代谢物、神经活性代谢物和炎症通过ENS/CNS的动态相互作用，将为ALS的预防和治疗提供创新见解。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的ALS患者队列和临床前研究，提出了微生物群-ENS-CNS轴在ALS中的新机制，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性横断面研究分析了135名ALS患者的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量，发现女性患者的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、红细胞沉降率（ESR）和咬肌厚度与男性患者存在显著差异，且这些差异在调整年龄、病程、BMI等变量后部分仍存在。研究提示，在解读ALS患者的炎症和超声指标时，应考虑性别和体型因素。
items.insight: 该研究系统揭示了ALS中炎症和神经肌肉超声指标的性别差异，为理解ALS临床异质性和个体化评估提供了新视角，提示未来研究需将性别作为重要协变量。

aiRead.keyFinding: 女性ALS患者的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度与男性患者存在显著差异，部分差异在调整协变量后仍存在。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法将超声差异归因于ALS特异性生物学；样本量有限且为单中心回顾性设计。
aiRead.watchNext: 需要前瞻性研究纳入健康对照组、纵向功能结局和身体成分评估，以验证这些性别差异的疾病特异性和预后价值。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，具有显著的临床异质性。全身性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在ALS中均有研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在检查ALS患者中常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用临床和人体测量变量后是否仍然存在。在这项回顾性横断面研究中，纳入了135名ALS患者。分析了常规炎症标志物，包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率（ESR），以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行了性别间比较，并应用错误发现率校正以处理多重检验。进行了多变量线性回归分析，调整了年龄、病程、体重指数（BMI）、ALSFRS-R总分、预测FVC%、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整的比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍存在显著差异，而ALSFRS-R差异为边缘显著。在完全调整的模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析后关联性不稳定。一项探索性二次分析显示，完全调整后，女性患者抬腿时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未出现在早期调整模型中而被谨慎解释。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者之间存在差异。这些发现支持在解释炎症标志物和基于超声的结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景，包括体型。由于缺乏健康对照组，观察到的超声差异不能具体归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照组、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究来阐明这些观察结果的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦ALS中常规炎症标志物和超声测量的性别差异，具有新近性和ALS相关性，为临床评估中的性别特异性解读提供了直接证据。

items.title: Multiplex Panel Detects Glial and Inflammatory Biomarker Signatures in Sporadic and C9orf72-ALS.
items.summary: CSF proteomics has emerged as a valuable strategy for identifying diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the limited availability and volumes of CSF samples restrict the broader clinical application of CSF-based biomarker panels. To address this challenge, we investigated whether the novel nucleic acid-linked immuno-sandwich assay (NULISA) multiplex platform-capable of quantifying multiple neural, glial, and inflammatory markers from minimal biofluid volumes-could validate previously proposed biomarkers and identify additional candidates relevant to ALS. Using this platform, we measured a targeted panel of 131 biomarkers in cohorts of patients with C9orf72-associated ALS, sporadic ALS (sALS), and matched healthy controls. The 6 markers neurofilament heavy chain (NEFH) and neurofilament light chain (NEFL), chitinases-particularly chitotriosidase-1 (CHIT1) and chitinase-3-like protein-1 (CHI3L1), and chemokines CCL2 and CCL3 were significantly elevated in both ALS groups compared with controls. These biomarkers correlated with disease progression and demonstrated strong diagnostic performance when combined into aggregate scores, as reflected by a high area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for ALS. Notably, C9orf72-ALS patients exhibited higher levels of the oxidative stress-related markers PRDX6 and ENO2, compared with sALS patients, suggesting a genotype-specific molecular signature. Overall, our findings support the use of a multiplexed panel of diverse, inflammatory, glial, and neurodegeneration-associated biomarkers as a complementary diagnostic and prognostic tool alongside established measurements of neurofilaments. This approach may enhance biomarker robustness while minimizing CSF volume requirements, thereby improving clinical feasibility in ALS research and care.
items.titleZh: 多重检测面板检测散发性和C9orf72-ALS中的胶质和炎症生物标志物特征
items.summaryZh: 本研究利用NULISA多重平台，在少量脑脊液中同时检测131种生物标志物，发现NEFL、NEFH、CHIT1、CHI3L1、CCL2和CCL3在ALS患者中显著升高，且C9orf72-ALS患者有独特的氧化应激标志物（PRDX6、ENO2）特征，支持多重面板作为ALS诊断和预后的补充工具。
items.insight: 该研究展示了NULISA平台在极小样本体积下同时检测多种生物标志物的能力，不仅验证了经典标志物（如NfL），还发现了C9orf72-ALS特有的氧化应激信号，为ALS亚型特异性生物标志物开发和临床转化提供了新方向。

items.abstractZh: 脑脊液蛋白质组学已成为识别肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）诊断和预后生物标志物的重要策略。然而，脑脊液样本的有限可用性和体积限制了基于脑脊液的生物标志物面板的更广泛临床应用。为应对这一挑战，我们研究了新型核酸连接免疫夹心检测（NULISA）多重平台——该平台能够从最小生物流体体积中定量多种神经、胶质和炎症标志物——是否能够验证先前提出的生物标志物并识别与ALS相关的其他候选标志物。使用该平台，我们在C9orf72相关ALS、散发性ALS（sALS）患者队列以及匹配的健康对照组中测量了131种生物标志物的靶向面板。与对照组相比，两种ALS组的6种标志物——神经丝重链（NEFH）和神经丝轻链（NEFL）、几丁质酶（特别是壳三糖苷酶-1（CHIT1）和几丁质酶-3样蛋白-1（CHI3L1））以及趋化因子CCL2和CCL3——显著升高。这些生物标志物与疾病进展相关，并在组合成聚合评分时表现出强大的诊断性能，如ALS的受试者工作特征曲线下面积较高所反映。值得注意的是，与sALS患者相比，C9orf72-ALS患者表现出更高水平的氧化应激相关标志物PRDX6和ENO2，提示存在基因型特异性分子特征。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持使用包含多种炎症、胶质和神经退行性相关生物标志物的多重面板，作为神经丝既定测量的补充诊断和预后工具。这种方法可以在最小化脑脊液体积需求的同时增强生物标志物的稳健性，从而提高ALS研究和护理中的临床可行性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，利用新型NULISA多重平台在ALS中实现低体积、高通量的生物标志物检测，直接关联ALS诊断和预后转化需求。

items.title: Are T1-weighted and T2-weighted volumetric pipelines interchangeable methodologies for investigating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathology in vivo?
items.summary: To test the hypothesis that T1-w and T2-w volumetric pipelines are not interchangeable, particularly regarding their differential sensitivity to physiological traits and disease effects in the red nucleus (RN) and substantia nigra (SN). Thirty-one patients with ALS (mean age: 59.39 ± 8.73 years; 23 males) and 21 non-neurodegenerative controls (mean age: 53.43 ± 10.01 years; 16 males). Bilateral RN and SN volumes were automatically extracted using deep learning pipelines optimized for T1-w (OpenMAP-T1) and T2-w (pBrain) images. Volumes were normalized to total intracranial volume. A 2 × 2 × 2 repeated-measures general linear model (GLM) assessed interactions between Method, Region, Side, and Group, controlling for age, sex, BMI, and handedness. There was no significant main effect of the disease group (p = 0.829) or Method × Group interaction (p = 0.682), indicating both pipelines agreed on the absence of disease-specific macrostructural atrophy. However, a significant four-way Method × Region × Side × Age interaction (P = 0.031) was observed. In the RN, the T2-w pipeline detected robust age-related atrophy (Left: Slope = -1.84 × 10 -6 ; Right: Slope = -1.70 ×10⁻⁶), whereas the T1-w pipeline did not (p > 0.05). Conversely, in the SN, T1-w consistently identified bilateral age-related loss, whereas T2-w yielded lateralized results (Right: p = 0.011; Left: P = 0.465). T1-w and T2-w pipelines are not interchangeable. Though both confirm the absence of gross atrophy in this ALS cohort, their differing sensitivity to physiological aging highlights their distinct biological tissue properties, requiring method-specific interpretation.
items.titleZh: T1加权与T2加权体积分析流程在肌萎缩侧索硬化症体内病理研究中的可互换性探讨
items.summaryZh: 本研究比较了T1加权和T2加权MRI体积分析流程在ALS患者红核和黑质中的表现。两种方法均未发现ALS相关的宏观结构萎缩，但对年龄相关变化的敏感性不同：T2加权对红核萎缩更敏感，而T1加权对黑质萎缩更敏感。这表明两种流程不可互换，需根据具体研究目标选择。
items.insight: 该研究提醒ALS研究者，在利用MRI体积分析评估脑干核团时，不同加权序列的流程可能对生理和病理变化有不同敏感性，需谨慎选择并解释结果，避免方法学偏差影响对ALS病理的理解。

items.abstractZh: 为检验T1加权（T1-w）和T2加权（T2-w）体积分析流程不可互换的假设，特别是两者对红核（RN）和黑质（SN）生理特征及疾病效应的敏感性差异。研究纳入31例ALS患者（平均年龄：59.39±8.73岁；23名男性）和21名非神经退行性对照组（平均年龄：53.43±10.01岁；16名男性）。使用针对T1-w（OpenMAP-T1）和T2-w（pBrain）图像优化的深度学习流程自动提取双侧RN和SN体积，并标准化至总颅内体积。采用2×2×2重复测量一般线性模型（GLM）评估方法、区域、侧别和组别间的交互作用，并控制年龄、性别、BMI和利手。未发现疾病组的主效应显著（p=0.829）或方法×组别交互作用显著（p=0.682），表明两种流程均一致显示无疾病特异性宏观结构萎缩。然而，观察到显著的四向方法×区域×侧别×年龄交互作用（p=0.031）。在RN中，T2-w流程检测到稳健的年龄相关萎缩（左侧：斜率=-1.84×10⁻⁶；右侧：斜率=-1.70×10⁻⁶），而T1-w流程未检测到（p>0.05）。相反，在SN中，T1-w一致识别出双侧年龄相关损失，而T2-w得出侧化结果（右侧：p=0.011；左侧：p=0.465）。T1-w和T2-w流程不可互换。尽管两者均确认该ALS队列中无大体萎缩，但它们对生理性衰老的不同敏感性凸显了其不同的生物组织特性，需要方法特异性解释。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，直接针对ALS中脑干核团（红核和黑质）的MRI体积分析方法学差异，具有高ALS相关性和转化价值，为未来多模态影像研究提供了关键方法学指导。

items.title: Deletion of exon 2 in ALS-linked Sptlc1 causes lethality in homozygous mice but not in heterozygotes.
items.summary: Mutations in the human SPTLC1 gene have recently been linked to early-onset amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), characterized by global atrophy, motor impairments, and symptoms such as tongue fasciculations. All known ALS-linked SPTLC1 mutations cluster within exon 2, and a specific variant, c.58G>T, results in exon 2 skipping. However, it is unclear how the exon 2 deletion affects SPTLC1 function in vivo and contributes to ALS pathogenesis. Leveraging the high genomic sequence similarity between mouse and human SPTLC1 , we created a novel knock-in mouse model with a CRISPR/Cas9-mediated deletion of exon 2 in the endogenous murine Sptlc1 locus. Although heterozygous mice did not develop motor defects or ALS-like neuropathology, homozygous mutants died prematurely. These findings provide valuable insights into SPTLC1 exon 2 biology and serve as a useful resource for future mechanistic studies.
items.titleZh: ALS相关Sptlc1基因外显子2缺失导致纯合子小鼠致死，但杂合子小鼠存活
items.summaryZh: 该研究通过CRISPR/Cas9技术构建了Sptlc1外显子2缺失的小鼠模型，发现纯合子小鼠致死，而杂合子小鼠未出现运动缺陷或ALS样病理，提示外显子2缺失可能通过剂量效应影响生存，但不足以单独引发ALS表型。
items.insight: 该研究直接验证了ALS相关SPTLC1突变（尤其是外显子2缺失）在体内的功能影响，为理解SPTLC1在ALS发病中的具体机制提供了关键动物模型，值得跟踪其后续的分子通路研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: Sptlc1外显子2缺失导致纯合子小鼠致死，但杂合子小鼠无运动缺陷或ALS样病理，表明该缺失可能通过剂量依赖性机制影响生存，而非直接引发ALS表型。
aiRead.limitation: 杂合子小鼠未表现出ALS表型，可能无法完全模拟人类疾病；研究未深入探讨外显子2缺失的分子机制或下游通路。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注该模型在应激或衰老条件下的表型变化，以及SPTLC1外显子2缺失对鞘脂代谢通路的具体影响。

items.abstractZh: 人类SPTLC1基因的突变最近被关联到早发性肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS），其特征为全身萎缩、运动障碍以及舌肌束颤等症状。所有已知的ALS相关SPTLC1突变均聚集在外显子2内，其中特定变异c.58G>T导致外显子2跳跃。然而，外显子2缺失如何影响SPTLC1在体内的功能并促进ALS发病机制尚不清楚。利用小鼠与人类SPTLC1之间高度相似的基因组序列，我们通过CRISPR/Cas9介导的内源性小鼠Sptlc1基因座外显子2缺失，创建了一种新型敲入小鼠模型。尽管杂合子小鼠未出现运动缺陷或ALS样神经病理学改变，但纯合子突变体过早死亡。这些发现为SPTLC1外显子2的生物学功能提供了有价值的见解，并为未来的机制研究提供了有用资源。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，直接针对新近发现的ALS相关SPTLC1突变，通过基因编辑小鼠模型揭示了外显子2缺失的体内效应，具有明确的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Association of Plasma Neurofilament Light Chain With Diagnostic Classification in a Neuromuscular Referral Cohort: A Cross-Sectional Study.
items.summary: Plasma neurofilament light chain (pNfL) is a blood-based biomarker of axonal injury elevated in several neuromuscular disorders. While previous studies have compared individual diseases with healthy controls, less is known about how pNfL performs across clinically relevant neuromuscular presentations encountered in subspecialty practice, particularly in distinguishing active from inactive neuropathies. We evaluated whether abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations are associated with clinically relevant diagnostic categories and whether pNfL discriminates between active and inactive neuropathies. We conducted a cross-sectional study of patients evaluated by neuromuscular specialists at Mayo Clinic (Rochester, MN) between April 2022 and April 2024, in whom pNfL was ordered as part of routine clinical care. Diagnoses were assigned to prespecified categories by consensus review, including motor neuron disease (MND), active neuropathy, inactive neuropathy, and structural etiologies. Clinically active neuropathy was defined using prespecified, diagnosis-specific operational criteria incorporating treatment status, clinical relapse or progression, time from symptom onset, and pathologic evidence of inflammation. Abnormal pNfL was defined using previously established age-adjusted 97.5th percentile reference limits. Multinomial logistic regression evaluated associations between abnormal pNfL and diagnostic category, adjusting for neuropathy impairment score and symptom duration. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses assessed discrimination between prespecified groups. Among 306 patients (mean age 62.2 years, 41.5% female), 179 (58.5%) had MND, 28 (9.1%) active neuropathy, 75 (12.1%) inactive neuropathy, and 24 (7.8%) structural etiologies. Median pNfL concentrations differed across diagnostic groups ( p < 0.0001) and were highest in MND and active neuropathy. After adjustment, abnormal pNfL was associated with a higher relative likelihood of classification as MND (relative risk ratio [RRR] 18.47, 95% CI 8.77-38.86) and active neuropathy (RRR 7.30, 95% CI 2.50-21.34) compared with inactive neuropathies. No association was observed with structural etiologies. Discrimination between active and inactive neuropathy was moderate (area under the curve [AUC] 0.79, 95% CI 0.70-0.88), and discrimination for MND vs all other diagnoses was good (AUC 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.90). In this cross-sectional cohort, abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations were more frequently observed in diagnostic categories characterized by clinically active axonal injury than in inactive neuropathies and structural conditions. These findings suggest a potential role for pNfL as an adjunctive tool in neuromuscular diagnostic evaluation. Interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional design and convenience sampling. This study provides Class II evidence that abnormal age-adjusted pNfL distinguishes active neuropathies from inactive neuropathies with moderate diagnostic accuracy.
items.titleZh: 血浆神经丝轻链与神经肌肉转诊队列中诊断分类的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究显示，在神经肌肉专科转诊队列中，血浆NfL水平在运动神经元病（包括ALS）和活动性神经病变患者中显著升高，并能以中等至良好的准确性区分活动性与非活动性神经病变，提示其作为临床辅助诊断工具的潜力。
items.insight: 该研究为pNfL在真实世界神经肌肉专科实践中的诊断价值提供了直接证据，特别是其区分活动性轴突损伤（如ALS）与非活动性病变的能力，有助于ALS的早期识别和鉴别诊断。

aiRead.keyFinding: 异常的年龄校正pNfL浓度在运动神经元病（MND）和活动性神经病变中显著升高，且能有效区分活动性与非活动性神经病变（AUC 0.79），以及MND与其他诊断（AUC 0.85）。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法评估纵向变化；便利抽样可能引入选择偏倚；样本量相对较小，且来自单一中心。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注pNfL在ALS患者中的纵向变化及其与疾病进展和预后的关联，以及其在多中心、前瞻性队列中的验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 血浆神经丝轻链（pNfL）是一种基于血液的轴突损伤生物标志物，在多种神经肌肉疾病中升高。虽然既往研究将个别疾病与健康对照进行了比较，但关于pNfL在亚专科实践中遇到的临床相关神经肌肉表现中的表现，尤其是在区分活动性与非活动性神经病变方面的表现，所知甚少。我们评估了异常的年龄校正pNfL浓度是否与临床相关的诊断类别相关，以及pNfL是否能区分活动性和非活动性神经病变。我们进行了一项横断面研究，纳入2022年4月至2024年4月期间在梅奥诊所（明尼苏达州罗切斯特）由神经肌肉专家评估的患者，这些患者作为常规临床护理的一部分接受了pNfL检测。通过共识审查将诊断分配至预设类别，包括运动神经元病（MND）、活动性神经病变、非活动性神经病变和结构性病因。临床活动性神经病变的定义采用预设的、诊断特异性的操作标准，包括治疗状态、临床复发或进展、症状发作时间以及炎症的病理学证据。异常pNfL的定义采用先前建立的年龄校正的第97.5百分位参考限值。多项逻辑回归评估了异常pNfL与诊断类别之间的关联，并调整了神经病变损伤评分和症状持续时间。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估了预设组之间的区分能力。在306例患者（平均年龄62.2岁，41.5%为女性）中，179例（58.5%）患有MND，28例（9.1%）患有活动性神经病变，75例（12.1%）患有非活动性神经病变，24例（7.8%）患有结构性病因。不同诊断组的中位pNfL浓度存在差异（p < 0.0001），且在MND和活动性神经病变中最高。校正后，与非活动性神经病变相比，异常pNfL与分类为MND（相对风险比[RRR] 18.47，95% CI 8.77-38.86）和活动性神经病变（RRR 7.30，95% CI 2.50-21.34）的相对可能性较高相关。未观察到与结构性病因的关联。活动性与非活动性神经病变之间的区分能力中等（曲线下面积[AUC] 0.79，95% CI 0.70-0.88），而MND与所有其他诊断的区分能力良好（AUC 0.85，95% CI 0.80-0.90）。在这个横断面队列中，异常的年龄校正pNfL浓度在临床活动性轴突损伤特征的诊断类别中比在非活动性神经病变和结构性病变中更常见。这些发现提示pNfL可能作为神经肌肉诊断评估中的辅助工具。横断面设计和便利抽样限制了结果的解释。本研究提供了II类证据，表明异常的年龄校正pNfL能以中等诊断准确性区分活动性神经病变与非活动性神经病变。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2022-2024年的临床数据，直接评估了pNfL在神经肌肉转诊队列中的诊断分类价值，为ALS等疾病的生物标志物临床应用提供了最新的真实世界证据。

items.title: Neurology ® Journal Club: Duration of Current Statin Use and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Risk.
items.summary: This article critically appraises the study by Nakken et al., "Duration of Current Statin Use and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) Risk." Previous observational studies and Mendelian randomization studies examining statin use and ALS risk have reported mixed results. Millions of adults receive statins for cardiovascular prevention and may be concerned when neuromuscular symptoms suggestive of ALS appear. Using linked nationwide health survey and prescription data, this Norwegian population-based cohort study applied time-dependent models to evaluate statin use and subsequent ALS risk. Short-term statin use was associated with increased ALS risk, whereas long-term use was associated with lower risk. The authors interpreted this as evidence of reverse causation rather than a causal or protective effect of statins. Key strengths of the study include its large population-based design, the use of a negative control, and time-dependent Cox modeling. However, limitations inherent to observational study designs and potential residual confounding should be considered. In this article, we summarize the findings, highlight key statistical concepts, and discuss the study's major strengths and limitations.
items.titleZh: 神经病学杂志俱乐部：当前他汀类药物使用持续时间与肌萎缩侧索硬化风险
items.summaryZh: 挪威大规模人群队列研究显示，短期他汀使用与ALS风险升高相关，长期使用则与风险降低相关，但作者认为这更可能是反向因果（即早期ALS症状导致用药调整）而非他汀的保护作用。研究采用时间依赖模型和阴性对照，但观察性设计无法排除残余混杂。
items.insight: 该研究通过精细的时间依赖分析，澄清了他汀使用与ALS风险之间看似矛盾的关系，提示短期风险升高可能源于反向因果（如未确诊的ALS症状促使停药或换药），而非他汀直接致病。这对临床医生解读他汀与神经肌肉症状的关联具有重要警示意义。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性队列研究（Journal Club评论）
aiRead.keyFinding: 短期他汀使用与ALS风险增加相关，长期使用与风险降低相关，但更支持反向因果解释。
aiRead.limitation: 观察性设计，残余混杂（如健康用户偏倚、适应症混杂）无法完全排除；反向因果解释虽合理但需进一步验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续孟德尔随机化研究或更精细的处方-症状时间窗分析，以区分因果与反向因果。

items.abstractZh: 本文对Nakken等人的研究《当前他汀类药物使用持续时间与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）风险》进行了批判性评估。既往观察性研究和孟德尔随机化研究关于他汀类药物使用与ALS风险的关系报告了不一致的结果。数百万成年人因心血管预防接受他汀类药物治疗，当出现提示ALS的神经肌肉症状时可能感到担忧。这项基于挪威全国健康调查和处方数据的队列研究，采用时间依赖模型评估了他汀类药物使用与后续ALS风险。短期他汀类药物使用与ALS风险增加相关，而长期使用与较低风险相关。作者将其解释为反向因果关系的证据，而非他汀类药物的因果或保护作用。该研究的主要优势包括其大规模人群基础设计、阴性对照的使用以及时间依赖Cox建模。然而，观察性研究设计固有的局限性和潜在的残余混杂因素应予以考虑。本文总结了研究结果，强调了关键统计概念，并讨论了研究的主要优势和局限性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，利用大规模全国性数据和时间依赖模型，为ALS风险因素中药物暴露的时序效应提供了新见解，直接关联他汀这一广泛用药的神经安全性。

items.source: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation
items.title: Interventional Procedures for Musculoskeletal Pain in ALS Patients: A Case Series.
items.summary: Many patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) experience musculoskeletal pain, yet data on the safety and efficacy of interventional procedures for pain relief in this population are limited. This study aims to describe the characteristics, outcomes, and procedural considerations of pain interventions performed for musculoskeletal pain in ALS patients. A retrospective chart review was conducted of ALS patients referred for interventional pain management by a neuromuscular physiatrist at a single academic institution's interdisciplinary ALS Center between February 2021 and February 2025. Eleven patients (mean age: 57 y, 64% male) underwent 14 procedures. Shoulder pain was the most common indication (43%), followed by spine (29%) and hip (14%) pain. Procedures mostly consisted of joint and bursal injections peripherally and of epidural injections in the axial spine. Overall, 13 of 14 (93%) procedures provided at least "good" pain relief, and 5 patients elected to repeat their procedures. One patient experienced transient postprocedure hypertension; no major complications occurred. Interventional procedures, particularly corticosteroid injections, appear to be safe and effective for managing focal musculoskeletal pain in patients with ALS. Tailored procedural techniques and multidisciplinary coordination can enhance comfort and optimize outcomes in this complex population.
items.titleZh: ALS患者肌肉骨骼疼痛的介入治疗：一项病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性病例系列研究显示，针对ALS患者的肌肉骨骼疼痛（尤其是肩部、脊柱和髋部疼痛），介入治疗（如皮质类固醇注射）在93%的手术中提供了至少“良好”的疼痛缓解，且未出现重大并发症。研究提示，在跨学科ALS中心，由神经肌肉康复医师主导的定制化介入疼痛管理是安全有效的。
items.insight: 该研究填补了ALS患者肌肉骨骼疼痛介入治疗安全性和有效性数据的空白，为临床实践中处理这一常见但常被忽视的症状提供了初步证据，强调了多学科协作和个体化治疗的重要性。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在ALS患者中，针对肌肉骨骼疼痛的介入治疗（主要为皮质类固醇注射）安全且有效，93%的手术提供了良好或更好的疼痛缓解。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量小（11名患者，14次手术），为单中心回顾性设计，缺乏对照组，且未报告长期随访结果。
aiRead.watchNext: 需要更大规模的前瞻性研究或随机对照试验来验证这些发现，并探索不同介入技术（如神经阻滞、射频消融）在ALS患者中的效果和安全性。

items.abstractZh: 许多肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者经历肌肉骨骼疼痛，然而关于该人群疼痛缓解介入治疗的安全性和有效性的数据有限。本研究旨在描述ALS患者因肌肉骨骼疼痛接受疼痛介入治疗的特征、结果和操作注意事项。对2021年2月至2025年2月期间，由一家学术机构的跨学科ALS中心的一名神经肌肉康复医师转诊接受介入疼痛管理的ALS患者进行了回顾性病历审查。11名患者（平均年龄：57岁，64%为男性）接受了14次手术。肩部疼痛是最常见的适应症（43%），其次是脊柱（29%）和髋部（14%）疼痛。手术主要包括外周关节和滑囊注射以及中轴脊柱的硬膜外注射。总体而言，14次手术中有13次（93%）提供了至少“良好”的疼痛缓解，5名患者选择重复手术。一名患者出现短暂术后高血压；未发生重大并发症。介入治疗，特别是皮质类固醇注射，对于管理ALS患者的局灶性肌肉骨骼疼痛似乎是安全有效的。量身定制的手术技术和多学科协调可以增强该复杂人群的舒适度并优化结果。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2021-2025年的近期临床数据，直接针对ALS患者这一特殊人群的疼痛管理需求，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Mutant superoxide dismutase 1-catalyzed hydrogen therapy for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis achieved by intercepting oxidative stress-neuroinflammation crosstalk.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the brain and spinal cord, with mutant superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) induced oxidative stress and neuroinflammation as key pathogenic drivers. Here, we uncover that mutant SOD1 is both a Fenton-like agent able for catalytical generation of ·OH and a hydrogenation catalyst for H 2 scavenging reactive oxygen species. To enhance the bioavailability of H 2 , we develop an orally administered Mg 2 Si nanosheets based feed for sustained release of high-amount H 2 . On an ALS model of hSOD1 G93A transgenic mice, Mg 2 Si feed remarkably delays ALS progression, improves the motor performance of ALS mice, and extends their lifespan. Histopathologically, oral Mg 2 Si treatment ameliorates motor neuron degeneration, misfolded SOD1 aggregation and reactive gliosis in spinal cord, while protecting neuromuscular junctions and ameliorating muscle atrophy during disease progression. Transcriptomic analysis demonstrates the H 2 -mediated down-regulation of both oxidative stress and neuroinflammatory pathways in response to the suppression of NLRP3 inflammasome activation. The proposed strategy of catalyzed hydrogen therapy offers an inspiration for metalloproteases-related neurodegenerative diseases treatment. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is an incurable and devastating neurodegenerative disease lacking effective clinical interventions. Although hydrogen gas (H 2 ) exhibits promising neuroprotective potential, conventional H 2 therapy is severely limited by unstable and transient H 2 release, failing to sustain long-term treatment requirements for chronic ALS pathogenesis. To overcome this bottleneck, we engineer oral administrable Mg 2 Si nanosheets that enable sustained H 2 release via gastrointestinal retention, achieving stable long-term hydrogen supplementation in vivo. Mechanistically, Mg 2 Si-derived H 2 efficiently eliminates excess free radicals triggered by toxic mutant SOD1, and further disrupts the pathological crosstalk between oxidative stress and neuroinflammation in ALS. In transgenic ALS mice, dietary Mg 2 Si intervention markedly ameliorates motor dysfunction and effectively delays disease progression. Collectively, this study firstly applies Mg 2 Si nanomaterial-based sustained hydrogen therapy for ALS treatment, establishes a novel gastrointestinal hydrogen delivery strategy, and provides an innovative and clinically translatable paradigm for the design of hydrogen delivery systems against neurodegenerative disorders.
items.titleZh: 突变超氧化物歧化酶1催化的氢疗法通过阻断氧化应激-神经炎症串扰治疗肌萎缩侧索硬化症
items.summaryZh: 该研究开发了一种口服Mg₂Si纳米片，可在胃肠道持续释放氢气，用于治疗SOD1突变型ALS。在转基因小鼠模型中，该疗法显著延缓疾病进展、改善运动功能并延长寿命，机制上通过清除自由基和抑制NLRP3炎症小体来阻断氧化应激与神经炎症的恶性循环。
items.insight: 该研究首次将基于Mg₂Si纳米材料的持续氢释放系统应用于ALS治疗，解决了传统氢气疗法释放不稳定、无法满足慢性病程需求的瓶颈，为SOD1突变型ALS提供了一种新颖、可口服且具有临床转化潜力的治疗策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: 口服Mg₂Si纳米片通过持续释放氢气，有效清除突变SOD1引发的自由基，抑制NLRP3炎症小体激活，从而阻断氧化应激与神经炎症的串扰，显著延缓SOD1 G93A转基因ALS小鼠的疾病进展并延长生存期。
aiRead.limitation: 该研究仅在SOD1 G93A转基因小鼠模型中进行验证，尚未在散发性ALS或其他基因突变型ALS模型中测试，且从动物到人体的转化效果和安全性有待进一步评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该团队是否推进Mg₂Si纳米片的临床前安全性评估，以及是否在更大动物模型或SOD1突变型ALS患者中开展初步临床试验。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是大脑和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退化，突变超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD1）诱导的氧化应激和神经炎症是关键致病驱动因素。在此，我们发现突变SOD1既是一种类芬顿试剂，能够催化产生·OH，也是一种氢化催化剂，用于H₂清除活性氧。为了提高H₂的生物利用度，我们开发了一种基于口服Mg₂Si纳米片的饲料，用于持续释放高剂量H₂。在hSOD1 G93A转基因小鼠的ALS模型中，Mg₂Si饲料显著延缓了ALS进展，改善了ALS小鼠的运动表现，并延长了其寿命。在组织病理学上，口服Mg₂Si治疗改善了脊髓中的运动神经元变性、错误折叠SOD1聚集和反应性胶质增生，同时保护了神经肌肉接头并改善了疾病进展期间的肌肉萎缩。转录组分析表明，H₂介导的氧化应激和神经炎症通路下调是对NLRP3炎症小体激活抑制的响应。所提出的催化氢疗法策略为金属蛋白酶相关的神经退行性疾病治疗提供了启示。意义声明：肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种无法治愈且破坏性的神经退行性疾病，缺乏有效的临床干预。尽管氢气（H₂）显示出有前景的神经保护潜力，但传统的H₂疗法受到不稳定和瞬时H₂释放的严重限制，无法满足慢性ALS发病机制的长期治疗需求。为克服这一瓶颈，我们设计了可口服的Mg₂Si纳米片，通过胃肠道滞留实现持续H₂释放，在体内实现稳定的长期氢补充。机制上，Mg₂Si衍生的H₂有效消除了由毒性突变SOD1引发的过量自由基，并进一步破坏了ALS中氧化应激和神经炎症之间的病理串扰。在转基因ALS小鼠中，饮食Mg₂Si干预显著改善了运动功能障碍，并有效延缓了疾病进展。总之，本研究首次将基于Mg₂Si纳米材料的持续氢疗法应用于ALS治疗，建立了一种新颖的胃肠道氢递送策略，并为针对神经退行性疾病的氢递送系统设计提供了创新且可临床转化的范式。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，首次提出利用Mg₂Si纳米材料实现胃肠道持续氢释放，直接靶向SOD1突变驱动的氧化应激-神经炎症串扰，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Evidence of stage-specific cognitive reserve effects on longitudinal cognition in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: About 50% of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) patients develop cognitive-behavioural impairment, yet longitudinal studies diverge on onset and extent of decline. Cognitive reserve (CR) may modulate cognitive trajectories, although longitudinal evidence remains limited. We aim to characterize cognitive trajectories in ALS and healthy aging and to examine the role of CR proxies in shaping cognitive change over time. About 268 participants (169 patients, 99 controls) were evaluated twice over 6 to 18 months using the Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS). Mixed models were used to predict initial ECAS performance (ECAS1), and cognitive slope (ECAS2-ECAS1) using CR proxies (education, work and leisure), ECAS21-ECAS12 interval, demographics (age, sex, psychiatric medication) and clinical factors (disease duration, onset-region, respiratory capacity, functional decline, C9orf72 mutation and behavioural symptoms). In patients, education (p < .001) and leisure (p < .001) positively predicted ECAS1. However, longitudinally, education and leisure had negative main effects on cognition, protecting against decline through interactions with clinical variables. In controls, more education and leisure predicted better cognition through main effects and interactions. CR appears to exhibit a dynamic, phase-dependent influence in patients and controls, supporting initial cognitive performance and potentially offering subtle protection as disease progresses. The observed non-linear effects of all CR proxies and subgroup-specific effects highlight the importance of considering clinical context, time and initial cognition when evaluating CR's role in ALS.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中阶段特异性认知储备对纵向认知影响的证据
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向研究分析了约268名参与者（169名ALS患者和99名健康对照），发现认知储备（通过教育、工作和休闲活动衡量）在ALS患者中具有阶段特异性作用：在疾病早期支持初始认知表现，而在疾病进展中通过与临床因素的交互作用提供微妙的保护。研究强调了评估认知储备时需考虑疾病阶段和临床背景。
items.insight: 该研究首次在ALS中系统揭示了认知储备的动态、阶段依赖性影响，为理解认知衰退的异质性提供了新视角，并提示针对不同疾病阶段设计认知干预策略的可能性。

aiRead.keyFinding: 认知储备在ALS患者中表现出阶段特异性：早期支持认知表现，后期通过与临床变量交互提供保护，且效应是非线性的。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量相对较小（169名患者），随访时间较短（6-18个月），且认知储备代理指标（教育、工作、休闲）的测量可能不够全面。
aiRead.watchNext: 需要更大样本、更长随访时间的研究来验证认知储备的阶段特异性效应，并探索针对不同疾病阶段的认知干预策略。

items.abstractZh: 约50%的肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者会出现认知行为障碍，然而纵向研究在认知衰退的起始时间和程度上存在分歧。认知储备（CR）可能调节认知轨迹，但纵向证据仍然有限。我们旨在描述ALS和健康衰老中的认知轨迹，并探讨CR代理指标在塑造随时间认知变化中的作用。约268名参与者（169名患者，99名对照）在6至18个月内接受了两次评估，使用爱丁堡认知和行为ALS筛查量表（ECAS）。采用混合模型，利用CR代理指标（教育、工作和休闲）、ECAS21-ECAS12间隔、人口统计学因素（年龄、性别、精神药物使用）和临床因素（病程、发病部位、呼吸能力、功能衰退、C9orf72突变和行为症状）预测初始ECAS表现（ECAS1）和认知斜率（ECAS2-ECAS1）。在患者中，教育（p < .001）和休闲（p < .001）正向预测ECAS1。然而，在纵向分析中，教育和休闲对认知有负向主效应，通过与临床变量的交互作用防止认知衰退。在对照组中，更多的教育和休闲通过主效应和交互作用预测更好的认知。CR似乎在患者和对照组中表现出动态的、阶段依赖的影响，支持初始认知表现，并可能在疾病进展中提供微妙的保护。所有CR代理指标的非线性效应和亚组特异性效应强调了在评估CR在ALS中的作用时考虑临床背景、时间和初始认知的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦ALS认知储备的纵向动态效应，具有新近性和直接的ALS相关性，为个性化认知管理提供了前沿证据。

items.title: A Phosphorylation-Induced Micellization Switch in the Low-Complexity Domain of TDP-43.
items.summary: Phase separation (PS) of the low-complexity domain (LCD) of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 kDa (TDP-43) is linked to pathogenic aggregates in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD-TDP). Here, we show that extensive phosphorylation of the LCD C-terminus redirects its self-assembly. Coarse-grained Monte Carlo simulations predicted that 12 Ser phosphorylations partition the 148-residue LCD into a hydrophobic N-terminal and highly charged C-terminal block, favouring finite-sized micellization over macroscopic PS. In vitro, LCD phosphorylated by casein kinase 1 delta (CK1δ; mean of 12 phosphorylations by native mass spectrometry) and phosphomimetic 12D/12DD mutants formed spherical nanoparticles (≈ 20-50 nm) above a low-micromolar critical micelle concentration, whereas the unphosphorylated LCD underwent reversible PS that matured into fibrils. Increasing ionic strength shifted the mutants toward anisotropic morphologies (wormlike 12D micelles and rigid 12DD nanocylinders). Turbidity assays and confocal imaging directly visualized the absence of PS in the phosphorylated form. Negative-stain and cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) confirmed the spherical micellar architecture for the phosphorylated LCD and 12D/12DD mimics. Our data identify phosphorylation as a molecular switch tuning macrophase separation and fibril formation of TDP-43 LCD, providing a framework for an aggregation-protective role through microphase separation into size-limited micelles. Whether these assemblies are stable or kinetically trapped on pathological timescales remains unclear.
items.titleZh: TDP-43低复杂度结构域中磷酸化诱导的胶束化开关
items.summaryZh: TDP-43蛋白的低复杂度结构域（LCD）在ALS中常发生异常聚集。本研究发现，LCD的C端被磷酸化后，会从形成纤维的相分离状态转变为形成约20-50纳米的球形胶束，从而避免形成大的聚集体。这一磷酸化开关可能是一种保护机制，但其在疾病中的稳定性尚待确认。
items.insight: 该研究首次揭示了磷酸化如何将TDP-43的相分离从致病性纤维化转向保护性胶束化，为理解ALS中TDP-43病理的调控机制提供了全新视角，并可能启发基于磷酸化模拟的治疗策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: TDP-43 LCD的磷酸化将其自组装从纤维化相分离转变为有限大小的球形胶束，可能发挥聚集保护作用。
aiRead.limitation: 磷酸化胶束在病理时间尺度上的稳定性未知，且研究仅在体外和模拟中进行，缺乏体内或疾病模型验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该磷酸化开关在ALS患者组织或动物模型中的验证，以及磷酸化模拟物是否能阻止TDP-43病理进展。

items.abstractZh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43 kDa（TDP-43）的低复杂度结构域（LCD）的相分离（PS）与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶变性（FTLD-TDP）中的致病性聚集体相关。在此，我们展示了LCD C末端的广泛磷酸化重新引导其自组装。粗粒蒙特卡洛模拟预测，12个丝氨酸磷酸化将148个残基的LCD分割成一个疏水的N端和一个高度带电的C端模块，有利于有限大小的胶束化而非宏观相分离。在体外，由酪蛋白激酶1δ（CK1δ；通过天然质谱平均12个磷酸化）磷酸化的LCD以及磷酸模拟物12D/12DD突变体在低微摩尔临界胶束浓度以上形成球形纳米颗粒（约20-50 nm），而未磷酸化的LCD则经历可逆的相分离并成熟为纤维。增加离子强度使突变体转向各向异性形态（蠕虫状12D胶束和刚性12DD纳米圆柱体）。浊度测定和共聚焦成像直接观察到磷酸化形式缺乏相分离。负染和冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）确认了磷酸化LCD和12D/12DD模拟物的球形胶束结构。我们的数据将磷酸化确定为调节TDP-43 LCD宏观相分离和纤维形成的分子开关，为通过微相分离成大小受限的胶束而发挥聚集保护作用提供了框架。这些组装体在病理时间尺度上是稳定的还是动力学捕获的仍不清楚。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，直接针对ALS核心病理蛋白TDP-43的聚集机制，提出了磷酸化作为分子开关的新概念，具有重要的转化价值。

items.title: Role of the Upper Motor Neuron in the Generation of Fasciculations in Early Disease Stages of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: The origin of fasciculation potentials (FPs) in the early stages of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) remains a subject of debate. We investigated the role of the motor cortex in FP generation by comparing resting FP frequency in the first dorsal interosseous (FDI) muscle before and after motor cortex inhibition induced by continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS). We studied patients with early-stage ALS (G1) and a disease-control group (G2) comprising individuals with chronic lower motor neuron (LMN) disorders or benign fasciculation syndrome without upper motor neuron (UMN) involvement. Inclusion required a right FDI strength of MRC grade 4+ or 5. At baseline, we recorded FP frequency and amplitude in the right FDI (3 replicates) and the motor evoked potential (MEP) amplitude. These measures were repeated immediately after cTBS-induced corticomotor inhibition. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. Twenty-two patients with ALS (14 men; median age 65.5 years; 72.7% spinal onset) were included, with a median disease duration of 6.4 months and a mean ALSFRS-R score of 44. The control group (G2) consisted of 11 participants. Notably, 50% of the ALS cohort showed no neurogenic features on needle EMG of the right FDI at enrollment. Baseline peripheral and cortical amplitudes and left hemisphere motor thresholds were comparable between groups. After cTBS, MEP amplitudes decreased significantly in both G1 (0.93 vs 0.50 mV, p = 0.02) and G2 (1.23 vs 0.38 mV, p = 0.02). However, a significant reduction in FP frequency (39.5%) occurred only in the ALS group (0.43 vs 0.26 Hz, p < 0.001), whereas no change was observed in G2 (0.60 vs 0.77 Hz, p = 0.14). Patients with ALS with a normal FDI EMG demonstrated an even greater reduction in FP frequency (54.5%). FP amplitudes remained stable across both groups after cTBS. Our findings indicate that in early ALS, LMN excitability is significantly modulated by descending corticospinal input. The reduction in FP frequency after cortical inhibition suggests that FPs in early ALS are driven by a combination of both UMN and LMN hyperexcitability, distinguishing them from fasciculations in other neurogenic disorders.
items.titleZh: 上运动神经元在肌萎缩侧索硬化早期疾病阶段肌束震颤产生中的作用
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过经颅磁刺激抑制运动皮层，发现早期ALS患者的肌束震颤频率显著下降，而其他神经源性疾病患者无此变化，提示ALS早期的肌束震颤由上、下运动神经元共同过度兴奋驱动。
items.insight: 该研究直接证明了上运动神经元对下运动神经元兴奋性的调控在ALS早期肌束震颤产生中的关键作用，为理解ALS的病理生理机制提供了新视角，并可能影响早期诊断和干预策略。

aiRead.keyFinding: 抑制运动皮层后，早期ALS患者的肌束震颤频率显著降低（39.5%），而其他神经源性疾病患者无变化，表明ALS早期肌束震颤由上、下运动神经元过度兴奋共同驱动。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（ALS组22例，对照组11例），且仅评估了单一肌肉（FDI），可能限制结果的普适性。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究可探索不同疾病阶段或不同肌肉中皮层抑制对肌束震颤的影响，以及该机制是否可作为早期ALS的生物标志物或治疗靶点。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）早期阶段肌束震颤电位（FPs）的起源仍存在争议。我们通过比较连续θ爆发刺激（cTBS）抑制运动皮层前后第一背侧骨间肌（FDI）的静息FP频率，研究了运动皮层在FP产生中的作用。研究对象包括早期ALS患者（G1）和疾病对照组（G2），后者由慢性下运动神经元（LMN）疾病或无上运动神经元（UMN）受累的良性肌束震颤综合征患者组成。纳入标准要求右侧FDI肌力为MRC 4+或5级。基线时，我们记录了右侧FDI的FP频率和振幅（3次重复）以及运动诱发电位（MEP）振幅。在cTBS诱导的皮层运动抑制后立即重复这些测量。统计学显著性设为p < 0.05。共纳入22例ALS患者（14名男性；中位年龄65.5岁；72.7%为脊髓起病），中位病程6.4个月，平均ALSFRS-R评分为44。对照组（G2）由11名参与者组成。值得注意的是，50%的ALS队列在入组时右侧FDI的针极肌电图未显示神经源性特征。两组间基线外周和皮层振幅以及左半球运动阈值相当。cTBS后，G1（0.93 vs 0.50 mV，p = 0.02）和G2（1.23 vs 0.38 mV，p = 0.02）的MEP振幅均显著下降。然而，仅在ALS组中观察到FP频率显著降低（39.5%）（0.43 vs 0.26 Hz，p < 0.001），而G2中无变化（0.60 vs 0.77 Hz，p = 0.14）。FDI肌电图正常的ALS患者FP频率降低更为显著（54.5%）。cTBS后两组FP振幅保持稳定。我们的发现表明，在早期ALS中，LMN兴奋性受到下行皮质脊髓输入的显著调节。皮层抑制后FP频率的降低提示，早期ALS中的FP是由UMN和LMN过度兴奋共同驱动的，这将其与其他神经源性疾病中的肌束震颤区分开来。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，首次通过皮层抑制实验直接证明ALS早期肌束震颤由上、下运动神经元共同驱动，具有重要的机制新近性和转化价值。

items.title: Plasma cardiac troponin T complements neurofilament light chain by reflecting disease phase and phenotypic variation in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Neurofilament light chain (NfL) is an established marker of neuronal injury and disease aggressiveness in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). In contrast, the clinical and biological significance of cardiac troponin T (cTnT) in ALS is not fully understood. We aimed to evaluate the relationship between plasma cTnT and disease aggressiveness, progression stage, and clinical phenotype in comparison with NfL. Plasma cTnT and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) NfL were analysed at diagnosis in a population-based cohort of 526 patients with ALS. Disease aggressiveness was modelled using the D50 framework, which quantifies the time taken to lose 50% of functional capacity (ALSFRS-R) and normalises individual disease trajectories. Biomarker associations with disease aggressiveness, phase, and clinical variables were assessed through group comparisons, logistic and linear regression, and receiver operating characteristic analyses. Neurofilament light chain in CSF was strongly associated with disease aggressiveness, with higher levels in patients with more aggressive disease. In contrast, plasma hs-cTnT did not correlate with D50. Across disease phases, CSF NfL remained relatively stable, whereas plasma hs-cTnT increased with advancing rD50, suggesting accumulation with disease progression. Plasma hs-cTnT levels were higher in patients with spinal compared to bulbar onset. Combined biomarker models improved sensitivity and negative predictive value for identifying less aggressive disease. Plasma hs-cTnT and CSF NfL capture distinct but complementary dimensions of ALS pathology. While NfL reflects disease aggressiveness, hs-cTnT aligns with disease phase and clinical phenotype, supporting its use as a complementary biomarker for ALS characterisation and monitoring.

items.summaryZh: 这项研究在526名ALS患者中发现，血浆心肌肌钙蛋白T（cTnT）与神经丝轻链（NfL）提供互补信息：NfL反映疾病侵袭性，而cTnT反映疾病阶段和起病类型（脊髓起病者更高）。联合使用两种标志物可提高识别低侵袭性疾病的准确性。

items.abstractZh: 神经丝轻链（NfL）是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中神经元损伤和疾病侵袭性的既定标志物。相比之下，心肌肌钙蛋白T（cTnT）在ALS中的临床和生物学意义尚未完全明确。本研究旨在评估血浆cTnT与疾病侵袭性、进展阶段和临床表型的关系，并与NfL进行比较。在一项基于人群的526例ALS患者队列中，于诊断时分析了血浆cTnT和脑脊液（CSF）NfL。使用D50框架对疾病侵袭性进行建模，该框架量化了丧失50%功能能力（ALSFRS-R）所需的时间，并标准化了个体疾病轨迹。通过组间比较、逻辑回归和线性回归以及受试者工作特征分析，评估了生物标志物与疾病侵袭性、阶段和临床变量的关联。CSF中的NfL与疾病侵袭性密切相关，侵袭性更强的患者水平更高。相比之下，血浆高灵敏度cTnT与D50无相关性。在不同疾病阶段，CSF NfL保持相对稳定，而血浆高灵敏度cTnT随rD50进展而升高，提示其随疾病进展而累积。脊髓起病患者的血浆高灵敏度cTnT水平高于延髓起病患者。联合生物标志物模型提高了识别侵袭性较低疾病的敏感性和阴性预测值。血浆高灵敏度cTnT和CSF NfL捕捉了ALS病理学中不同但互补的维度。NfL反映疾病侵袭性，而高灵敏度cTnT与疾病阶段和临床表型一致，支持其作为ALS特征描述和监测的补充生物标志物。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，基于526例ALS患者的大样本队列，首次明确血浆cTnT与NfL在ALS中反映不同病理维度，具有直接的转化价值，为ALS生物标志物组合策略提供了新证据。

items.title: Longitudinal plasma proteomics predict phenoconversion to clinically manifest ALS.
items.summary: The study of pre-symptomatic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and the design of disease prevention trials are greatly hampered by our inability to predict which unaffected carriers of ALS-associated pathogenic variants will phenoconvert to clinically manifest disease and when. In this longitudinal Olink Explore, high-throughput, proteomic study, 516 serially collected plasma samples from 33 phenoconverters, 35 patients with ALS, 10 pre-symptomatic pathogenic variant carriers and 59 controls were included. Here we identified 92 proteins with concentrations that changed before phenoconversion; characterized the longitudinal trajectory of these proteins and identified a core panel of 19 proteins which, collectively, predicted phenoconversion over the 0.5-year to 5-year time horizons (crossvalidated areas under the curve 0.80-0.89) and yielded estimates of time to phenoconversion with a mean absolute error of 1.6 years. These findings were partially replicated in UK Biobank data, confirming pre-symptomatic increases in several proteins (for example, NEFL, EDA2R and CA3) and that a multi-protein panel outperformed NEFL alone in estimating time to phenoconversion. This work sheds light on the biology of pre-symptomatic ALS. Moreover, our identification of a panel of new susceptibility/risk biomarkers based on empirical longitudinal data furthers the ultimate goal of ALS prevention.

items.abstractZh: 对症状前肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的研究以及疾病预防试验的设计，很大程度上受限于我们无法预测哪些携带ALS相关致病变异的未受影响个体会发生表型转化（即出现临床症状）以及何时发生。在这项纵向的Olink Explore高通量蛋白质组学研究中，纳入了来自33名表型转化者、35名ALS患者、10名症状前致病变异携带者和59名对照者的516份连续采集的血浆样本。我们鉴定出92种在表型转化前浓度发生变化的蛋白质；描述了这些蛋白质的纵向轨迹，并确定了一个由19种蛋白质组成的核心组合，该组合在0.5年至5年的时间范围内预测了表型转化（交叉验证曲线下面积0.80-0.89），并给出了表型转化时间的估计值，平均绝对误差为1.6年。这些发现在英国生物银行数据中得到部分重复，证实了多种蛋白质（例如NEFL、EDA2R和CA3）在症状前阶段的升高，并且多蛋白组合在估计表型转化时间方面优于单独的NEFL。这项工作揭示了症状前ALS的生物学机制。此外，基于经验性纵向数据识别出一组新的易感性/风险生物标志物，进一步推动了ALS预防的最终目标。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，利用高通量蛋白质组学在症状前ALS携带者中建立多蛋白预测模型，直接关联ALS早期诊断和预防的转化需求，具有高度前沿性。
